_readme: The product catalogue and the price list. This is the commercial heart of
the site: six SKUs (three grades x two bag sizes) sold by the pallet to
distributors and retailers. tools/build.py renders the product cards, the
price table and the volume tiers from this file; js/site.js reads it at
EVERY PRICE IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER. `price_status` is 'placeholder',
which makes the pages render a visible amber banner over every price. Put
the real numbers in, set `price_status` to 'live' and set `effective_date`,
and the banners disappear on the next build. Nothing else has to change.
Price model: `list_per_bag` is the price of one bag when buying a single
pallet. `tiers` discount that by pallet count. Pallet price is derived
(bags_per_pallet x per-bag price), never stored, so the two can never
disagree. `suggested_shelf` is a margin reference for the buyer, not a
price we sell at and not a condition of sale.
